articles.title: Game Information: October 13 Winnipeg Jets vs. Minnesota Wild
PREVIEW: Blackhawks Continue Homestand Against Penguins
Bedard to make season debut for Blackhawks against Penguins

away.summary: The Winnipeg Jets (4-1-1) are coming off a win against the Minnesota Wild and aim to continue their strong defensive play. They are projected to use Stuart Skinner in goal and have several key players out due to injury, including Elias Salomonsson (shoulder), Walker Duehr (lower body), Garrett Brown (lower body), and Josh Morrissey (upper body), with Morrissey listed as day to day. The Jets are hoping to build on their defensive structure and get contributions from lines like Koepke’s, which has shown improvement in recent games.

home.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks (2-5-0) are on a seven-game home stand and recently won 5-3 over the Pittsburgh Penguins, with Connor Bedard making his season debut after off-season shoulder surgery. Bedard played 21:04, recorded an assist, and won six of 14 face-offs. The Blackhawks are projected to start Spencer Knight in goal, and they continue to rely on their young core, with 66.7% of their points coming from players 25-or-younger. They look to gain ground in the Central Division but face a Jets team aiming to disrupt their momentum.
